fields.headline: Approves the 2020-21 school safety plan for Coliseum College Prep Academy
fields.summary: The Board approves the 2020-2021 Comprehensive Safety Plan for Coliseum College Preparatory Academy, presented by the Chief of Police Services. The official action text names Oakland High School, but the title and the attached plan are for Coliseum College Prep; Oakland High's plan is a separate item (20-0291). No dollar amount is listed.
